quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph could take up to ____ to come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers need much longer distances to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer may need almost 400 feet to stop when driving at 55 mph.

questions.question: When someone is tailgating you:

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane is open, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed. This lets the tailgater pass you.

questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, move to the right lane if possible. If no right lane exists, wait for clear road ahead and slowly reduce speed to let them pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking rules that drivers must follow. Where this sign is posted, you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: A fire engine is behind you on a two-lane street without its emergency lights on. You should:

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is behind you without its siren or flashing lights on, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is:
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this symbol are driving at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and give the right-of-way to traffic already in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: It is important to be alert to motorcycles because:

options.text: They are more difficult to see than cars.
Motorcyclists are less skilled drivers than other motorists.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are more difficult to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and harder to see than cars. They can easily hide in a car's blind spot. It is hard to judge distance and speed with motorcycles, so always be careful around them.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive as you would on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead. Your vehicle will need more time to stop than on dry roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can turn left or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs show no passing zones. The sign will have text to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: If a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what should you do?

options.text: You may still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
You may no longer turn and must go straight.
You still have the right-of-way to turn.
You no longer have to turn in the direction the arrow pointed.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may still turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you can still turn in the direction the arrow pointed. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does NOT affect how far a vehicle needs to stop?

options.text: The condition and type of your tires.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: When may you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.

questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines, but not solid lines. You may cross a solid yellow line only when you are turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: When you see a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line with the broken line next to your lane, when may you pass?
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane, you may cross to pass if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. What must you do?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
Tell the other vehicle to pull over.
Turn on your high beams so they see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give oncoming vehicles at least half of the road. Both drivers need space to pass each other safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm. Steer toward the direction the skid is going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely before going through the intersection.

questions.question: A steady yellow light means a ____ light will come next.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a steady red light is coming soon.

questions.question: Your car is in an accident and is blocking traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Move your car off the road if you can.
Do not move your car at all.
Wait for police before moving your car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your car off the road if you can.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your car off the road if possible. Never leave the scene without giving your information and helping if needed.

questions.question: When turning left, you have the right-of-way with which light?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction. Oncoming traffic must stop. You have the right-of-way.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does it mean?

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts right at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced zone.
Reduce to 35 mph only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts right at this sign.
questions.explanation: Reduced speed signs tell you to lower your speed. When a new speed limit is shown on the sign, that limit begins right at the sign.

questions.question: An oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.

questions.explanation: Honk your horn to get their attention. If they do not move, steer to the right. Do not steer left because they might correct and you will still crash. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the crash impact.

questions.question: Traffic lanes moving in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. Solid white lines cannot be crossed. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions.

questions.question: A driver behind you wants to pass. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down to give them room to pass safely and quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give them room to pass safely and quickly.
questions.explanation: Slow down when someone behind you wants to pass. This gives them enough space to complete the pass easily and quickly.

questions.question: Before you turn left, you should:

options.text: Move to the right side of your lane.
Wait for oncoming traffic to get a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic light, you must let pedestrians and oncoming cars go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They prepare you for hazards and road changes. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge in safely.

questions.question: When turning left on a multilane, one-way street or highway, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: Always start from the left lane when turning left on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: When do roads become very slippery?

options.text: After it has been raining for an hour or more.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads become very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The rain brings oil to the road surface. In hot weather, this is even worse.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before changing lanes to the left, where should you look?
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to turn to check your blind spot.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Get ready to stop because the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you can go, but you must drive slowly and carefully. Look both ways before entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: You reach an intersection where you want to turn, but you are not in the proper lane. What should you do?

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Turn on your blinker and make the turn anyway.
Drive to the next intersection and turn there.
Safely change lanes, then back up to return to the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the next intersection and turn there.
questions.explanation: Never make a last-minute turn. If you are not in the correct lane, drive to the next intersection and turn from the proper lane.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means trucks are not allowed in this area. Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) is affected by all of the following except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not be able to safely pass a truck on it. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between traffic lanes mean?

options.text: Drivers may pass, even if it is dangerous.
Drivers may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road hazards. This sign warns you that a bridge ahead has narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road hazards. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: Which statement about emergency vehicles is true?

options.text: They have the right-of-way when using sirens, horns, and flashing lights.
They may use a loudspeaker to give instructions.

questions.explanation: You must yield to police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and other emergency vehicles using sirens or air horns with red or blue flashing lights. Follow any instructions given over their loudspeakers. Emergency vehicles often follow each other, so only proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around immediately and go a different way.

questions.question: If an oncoming vehicle has high beams on, look toward ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: Look to the right side of the road if an oncoming vehicle uses high beams. This prevents you from being blinded and lets you see the road well enough to stay on course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: What do round signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers of an upcoming railroad crossing. Use extra caution when approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road hazards. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on speed and road conditions.
